lead_identities.ddl:
CREATE TABLE lead_identities (
	lead_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	phone_normalized VARCHAR(20), 
	email_normalized VARCHAR(254), 
	owner_user_id UUID, 
	merged_into_id UUID, 
	source VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	environment_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_lead_identities_lead UNIQUE (lead_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_lead_identity_phone UNIQUE (tenant_id, environment_id, phone_normalized), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_lead_identity_email UNIQUE (tenant_id, environment_id, email_normalized), 
	FOREIGN KEY(lead_id) REFERENCES leads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(merged_into_id) REFERENCES leads (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(environment_id) REFERENCES environments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_lead_identities_scope ON lead_identities (tenant_id, environment_id)

	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_lead_status_history_lead ON lead_status_history (tenant_id, environment_id, lead_id)
